6.2.s: 1 atha caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmyaprastāva umāmaheśvarasaṃvādārambhaḥ, tatra prathamamagastyeśvararaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatprasaṃgena pūrvetihāsavarṇanam, tatra devānāṃ sukhaprāptyarthaṃ kuṃbhayoninā daityānhatvā paścāttāpena hatyādoṣabhīteneśvarārādhanā kṛtvā śivānujñayā svanāmnā śivaliṃgasthāpanam, tasyāgastyeśvaraliṃgasya māhātmyayavarṇanam 79 5
6.2.d: 1 अथ चतुरशीतिलिंगमाहात्म्यप्रस्ताव उमामहेश्वरसंवादारम्भः, तत्र प्रथममगस्त्येश्वररलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्प्रसंगेन पूर्वेतिहासवर्णनम्, तत्र देवानां सुखप्राप्त्यर्थं कुंभयोनिना दैत्यान्हत्वा पश्चात्तापेन हत्यादोषभीतेनेश्वराराधना कृत्वा शिवानुज्ञया स्वनाम्ना शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, तस्यागस्त्येश्वरलिंगस्य माहात्म्ययवर्णनम् 79 5
6.2.m: 1. Now, the introduction to the Glory of the Eighty-Four Liṅgas: the beginning of the dialogue between Umā and Maheśvara; therein, first, the description of the glory of the Agastyeśvara liṅga; in that connection, the narrative of past events; therein, the jar-born sage killing the Daityas to secure happiness for the gods; his worship of Īśvara, overwhelmed by repentance and fearing the guilt of killing; by Śiva's permission, the installation of a Śivaliṅga in his own name; the description of the glory of that Agastyeśvara liṅga. 79 5

6.2.s: 2 atha guheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra maṃkaṇakaṛṣiṇā tapastaptvā kasmiṃścitsamaye karācchākarasanirgamanenāścaryaṃ prāpya nartanakaraṇam, tena sarveṣāṃ sthāvarajaṃgamānāṃ saṃjātaṃ nṛtyaṃ dṛṣṭvā devānāṃ śivalokegamanam, śivena tasya maṃkaṇakasya śaṃkānirāsakaraṇa, śivājñayā mahākālavane liṃgasthāpanama, maṃkaṇakarṣermuktiprāptivarṇanam, guheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam...... 80 2
6.2.d: 2 अथ गुहेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मंकणकऋषिणा तपस्तप्त्वा कस्मिंश्चित्समये कराच्छाकरसनिर्गमनेनाश्चर्यं प्राप्य नर्तनकरणम्, तेन सर्वेषां स्थावरजंगमानां संजातं नृत्यं दृष्ट्वा देवानां शिवलोकेगमनम्, शिवेन तस्य मंकणकस्य शंकानिरासकरण, शिवाज्ञया महाकालवने लिंगस्थापनम, मंकणकर्षेर्मुक्तिप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, गुहेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्...... 80 2
6.2.m: 2. Now, the description of the glory of the Guheśvara liṅga; therein, the seer Maṅkaṇaka practicing austerity; at a certain time, upon sap flowing from his hand, being filled with wonder, his dancing; the dancing of all mobile and immobile beings triggered by that; seeing this, the gods going to Śivaloka; Śiva dispelling that doubt of Maṅkaṇaka; by Śiva's command, the installation of a liṅga in the Mahākāla forest; the description of the seer Maṅkaṇaka attaining liberation; the description of the glory of Guheśvara. 80 2

6.2.s:
3 atha ḍhuṃḍheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra ḍhuṃḍhanāmakaśaivagaṇasyendrasabhāyāṃ gamanam,
nṛtyamānāṃ raṃbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmamohitasya ḍhuṃḍhasyendreṇa śāpapradānam, tato mānuṣyaṃ
prāpya ḍhuṃḍhena mahākālavane śivamārādhya svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, ḍhuṃḍheśvaratīrthaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam
6.2.d:
3 अथ ढुंढेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र ढुंढनामकशैवगणस्येन्द्रसभायां गमनम्,
नृत्यमानां रंभां दृष्ट्वा काममोहितस्य ढुंढस्येन्द्रेण शापप्रदानम्, ततो मानुष्यं
प्राप्य ढुंढेन महाकालवने शिवमाराध्य स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, ढुंढेश्वरतीर्थलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्
6.2.m: 3. Now, the description of the glory of Ḍhuṇḍheśvara; therein, the Śaiva attendant named Ḍhuṇḍha going to Indra's assembly; seeing Rambhā dancing, Ḍhuṇḍha, bewildered by passion, being cursed by Indra; then, obtaining human form, Ḍhuṇḍha worshipping Śiva in the Mahākāla forest and installing a liṅga in his own name; the description of the glory of the Ḍhuṇḍheśvara tīrtha-liṅga.

6.2.s:
4 atha ḍamarukeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra ruruputreṇa vajradaityena saha yuddhe parājayaṃ
prāptānāṃ sendrādidevānāṃ brahmaloke gamanam, brahmaṇaḥ śarīrato nirgatāyāḥ saka-
nyakāyāḥ kṛtyāyā vajreṇa samaṃ yuddhavarṇanam, vajrakṛtakṛtyāparābhavavarṇanam,
kṛtyādibhirīśvarārādhanākaraṇam, īśvaravajrayoryuddhavarṇanam, īśvarapreritaḍamaruṇā
vajranāśakaraṇam, tatastatra ḍamarukeśvaretiliṃgasthāpanam, ḍamarukeśvaraliṃgamāhā-
tmyavarṇanam .. .... ... - ... 82 1
6.2.d:
4 अथ डमरुकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र रुरुपुत्रेण वज्रदैत्येन सह युद्धे पराजयं
प्राप्तानां सेन्द्रादिदेवानां ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, ब्रह्मणः शरीरतो निर्गतायाः सक-
न्यकायाः कृत्याया वज्रेण समं युद्धवर्णनम्, वज्रकृतकृत्यापराभववर्णनम्,
कृत्यादिभिरीश्वराराधनाकरणम्, ईश्वरवज्रयोर्युद्धवर्णनम्, ईश्वरप्रेरितडमरुणा
वज्रनाशकरणम्, ततस्तत्र डमरुकेश्वरेतिलिंगस्थापनम्, डमरुकेश्वरलिंगमाहा-
त्म्यवर्णनम् .. .... ... - ... 82 1
6.2.m: 4. Now, the description of the glory of Ḍamarukeśvara; therein, the gods led by Indra, having suffered defeat in battle with the Daitya Vajra, the son of Ruru, going to Brahmaloka; the description of the battle with Vajra by the female demon همراه with maiden-attendants that issued from Brahmā's body; the description of the defeat of that female demon by Vajra; the performance of the worship of Īśvara by the female demon and others; the description of the battle between Īśvara and Vajra; the destruction of Vajra by the hand-drum propelled by Īśvara; then, the installation of the liṅga named Ḍamarukeśvara there; the description of the glory of the Ḍamarukeśvara liṅga. 82 1
5. Now, the description of the glory of the Anādikalpeśvara liṅga. 83 1

6.2.s: 6 atha svarṇajāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra pārvatyā saha krīḍataḥ śaṃkarasya vīryaprāśanena vahninā taddāhaśamanārthaṃ gaṃgāyāmavaloḍanakaraṇam, tato vahneḥ kāñcananāmakaprathamāpatyasya darśanena sarvatra vādapracalanam, tamanarthaṃ dṛṣṭvā vahninā śaṃkarāya kāṃcanaputrasya samarpaṇam, śaṃkarājñayā kāñcanasya mahākālavane gamanam, kāñcanena tapastaptvā īśvaravacanātsvanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, svarṇajāleśvaraliṃga māhātmyavarṇanam .... .. ... 84 1
6.2.d: 6 अथ स्वर्णजालेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पार्वत्या सह क्रीडतः शंकरस्य वीर्यप्राशनेन वह्निना तद्दाहशमनार्थं गंगायामवलोडनकरणम्, ततो वह्नेः काञ्चननामकप्रथमापत्यस्य दर्शनेन सर्वत्र वादप्रचलनम्, तमनर्थं दृष्ट्वा वह्निना शंकराय कांचनपुत्रस्य समर्पणम्, शंकराज्ञया काञ्चनस्य महाकालवने गमनम्, काञ्चनेन तपस्तप्त्वा ईश्वरवचनात्स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, स्वर्णजालेश्वरलिंग माहात्म्यवर्णनम् .... .. ... 84 1
6.2.m: 6. Now, the description of the glory of the Svarṇajāleśvara liṅga; therein, Agni, having consumed the semen of Śaṃkara while he sportingly dallied with Pārvatī, tossing about in the Gaṅgā to quench its burning heat; then, at the appearance of Agni's firstborn child named Kāñcana, a debate arising everywhere; seeing that calamity, Agni surrendering the son Kāñcana to Śaṃkara; by Śaṃkara's command, Kāñcana going to the Mahākāla forest; Kāñcana performing austerity and, at Īśvara's word, installing a liṅga in his own name; the description of the glory of the Svarṇajāleśvara liṅga. 84 1

6.2.s: 7 atha triviṣṭapeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra nāradavacanānmahākālavane triviṣṭapairliṃgasthāpanam, triviṣṭapeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- .. ... 85 1
6.2.d: 7 अथ त्रिविष्टपेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र नारदवचनान्महाकालवने त्रिविष्टपैर्लिंगस्थापनम्, त्रिविष्टपेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- .. ... 85 1
6.2.m: 7. Now, the description of the glory of the Triviṣṭapeśvara liṅga; therein, the installation of a liṅga in the Mahākāla forest by the gods at the word of Nārada; the description of the glory of the Triviṣṭapeśvara liṅga. 85 1

6.2.s: 8 atha kapāleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra mahākālavane paitāmahayajñe haste kapālaṃ dhṛtvā śaṃkarasyāgamanam, śaṃkarasya kucelaveṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇairapamānakaraṇam, tataḥ śivena tatra yajñamaṇḍape kapālaṃ nidhāya gamanam, tadasahamānairbrāhmaṇairmaṇḍapādbahiḥ kapālaprakṣepaṇam, tataḥ sahasrāvadhikapālānāṃ darśanam, tadadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā savismayairbrāhmaṇaiḥ śivastavanakaraṇam, kapāleśvaranāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, kapāleśvaraliṃgadarśanena brahmahatyādimahāpātakavināśakamāhātmyavarṇanam ... . 86 1
6.2.d: 8 अथ कपालेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र महाकालवने पैतामहयज्ञे हस्ते कपालं धृत्वा शंकरस्यागमनम्, शंकरस्य कुचेलवेषं दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणैरपमानकरणम्, ततः शिवेन तत्र यज्ञमण्डपे कपालं निधाय गमनम्, तदसहमानैर्ब्राह्मणैर्मण्डपाद्बहिः कपालप्रक्षेपणम्, ततः सहस्रावधिकपालानां दर्शनम्, तदद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा सविस्मयैर्ब्राह्मणैः शिवस्तवनकरणम्, कपालेश्वरनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, कपालेश्वरलिंगदर्शनेन ब्रह्महत्यादिमहापातकविनाशकमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... . 86 1
6.2.m: 8. Now, the description of the glory of the Kapāleśvara liṅga; therein, the arrival of Śaṃkara holding a skull in his hand at Brahmā's sacrifice in the Mahākāla forest; the brahmins disrespecting Śaṃkara upon seeing his ragged appearance; then Śiva, placing the skull in the sacrificial pavilion, departing; the brahmins, unable to tolerate it, throwing the skull outside the pavilion; then the sight of thousands of skulls; the amazed brahmins, beholding that miracle, singing praise to Śiva; the installation of a liṅga under the name Kapāleśvara; the description of the glory that destroys grave sins such as the killing of a brahmin through the darśana of the Kapāleśvara liṅga. 86 1

6.2.s: 9 atha svargadvāraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra dakṣayajñe dakṣakṛtenāpamānena saṃkruddhasya śivasyājñayā vīrabhadrādiśaivagaṇānāṃ viṣṇvādidevaiḥ saha yuddhavarṇanam, tatra viṣṇvādidevānāṃ parābhavaḥ, śaivagaṇaiḥ svargadvāranirbandhanakaraṇam, devaiḥ svargapraveśābhāvaṃ samavalokya viṣṇvājñayā śivārādhanārthamahākālavane gamanam, tatra svargadvāranāmaka liṃgasthāpanam, svargadvāraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam........ 87 1
6.2.d: 9 अथ स्वर्गद्वारलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र दक्षयज्ञे दक्षकृतेनापमानेन संक्रुद्धस्य शिवस्याज्ञया वीरभद्रादिशैवगणानां विष्ण्वादिदेवैः सह युद्धवर्णनम्, तत्र विष्ण्वादिदेवानां पराभवः, शैवगणैः स्वर्गद्वारनिर्बन्धनकरणम्, देवैः स्वर्गप्रवेशाभावं समवलोक्य विष्ण्वाज्ञया शिवाराधनार्थमहाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र स्वर्गद्वारनामक लिंगस्थापनम्, स्वर्गद्वारलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्........ 87 1
6.2.m: 9. Now, the description of the glory of the Svargadvāra liṅga; therein, by the command of Śiva who was angered by the insult offered by Dakṣa at the sacrifice of Dakṣa, the description of the battle of the Śaiva attendants led by Vīrabhadra with the gods led by Viṣṇu; therein, the defeat of the gods led by Viṣṇu; the Śaiva attendants barricading the gates of heaven; the gods, seeing their inability to enter heaven, going to the Mahākāla forest by Viṣṇu's command to worship Śiva; the installation of the liṅga named Svargadvāra there; the description of the glory of the Svargadvāra liṅga. 87 1

6.2.s: 10 atha karkoṭakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra mātṛdattaśāpavināśārtha karkoṭakanāgena mahākālavane tapaścaraṇam, tattapaḥprasannena śivena tasmai varapradānam, śivaliṃgasya svanāmnā sthāpanam, karkoṭakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... 88 1
6.2.d: 10 अथ कर्कोटकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मातृदत्तशापविनाशार्थ कर्कोटकनागेन महाकालवने तपश्चरणम्, तत्तपःप्रसन्नेन शिवेन तस्मै वरप्रदानम्, शिवलिंगस्य स्वनाम्ना स्थापनम्, कर्कोटकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... 88 1
6.2.m: 10. Now, the description of the glory of the Karkoṭakeśvara liṅga; therein, the snake Karkoṭaka practicing austerity in the Mahākāla forest to destroy a curse given by his mother; Śiva, pleased by that austerity, granting a boon to him; the installation of a Śivaliṅga in his own name; the description of the glory of the Karkoṭakeśvara liṅga. 88 1

6.2.s: 11 atha siddheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanama, tatra siddhiprāptyartha devadāruvane tapaḥ kurvāṇe viprairākāśavāṇīśravaṇānmahākālavane gamanam, tatra tapastaptvā siddhiprāptidaliṃgasthāpanam, siddheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanama ... 88
6.2.d: 11 अथ सिद्धेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम, तत्र सिद्धिप्राप्त्यर्थ देवदारुवने तपः कुर्वाणे विप्रैराकाशवाणीश्रवणान्महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा सिद्धिप्राप्तिदलिंगस्थापनम्, सिद्धेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम ... 88
6.2.m: 11. Now, the description of the glory of the Siddheśvara liṅga; therein, while practicing austerity in the Devadāru forest to attain perfection, brahmins going to the Mahākāla forest upon hearing a voice from the sky; performing austerity there, the installation of a liṅga that grants perfection; the description of the glory of the Siddheśvara liṅga. 88

6.2.s: 12 atha lokapāleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sakāśātsañjātaparābhavairlokapālairviṣṇvājñayā tapaścaraṇāya mahākālavane gamanam, tapaḥprabhāvena daityāñjitvā svasvasthāne prati gamanam, lokapāletināmnā mahākālavane liṃgasthāpanam, lokapāleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam -... ....... 89
6.2.d: 12 अथ लोकपालेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र हिरण्यकशिपोः सकाशात्सञ्जातपराभवैर्लोकपालैर्विष्ण्वाज्ञया तपश्चरणाय महाकालवने गमनम्, तपःप्रभावेन दैत्याञ्जित्वा स्वस्वस्थाने प्रति गमनम्, लोकपालेतिनाम्ना महाकालवने लिंगस्थापनम्, लोकपालेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् -... ....... 89
6.2.m: 12. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Lokapāleśvara liṅga: there, the guardians of the worlds, having suffered defeat at the hands of Hiraṇyakaśipu, went to the Mahākāla forest by command of Viṣṇu to perform tapas; having conquered the daityas through the power of their tapas, they returned to their respective abodes; the installation of a liṅga under the name 'Lokapāla' in the Mahākāla forest; the description of the māhātmya of the Lokapāleśvara liṅga. (89)

6.2.s: 13 atha kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanama, tatra brahmaṇā muṣṭinirmāpaṇārthaṃ kāmamutpādya tasya dvādaśasthānāni dattvā śivopari kāmoddīpanārthaṃ preṣaṇam, śivena svatapaso vighnakāriṇaḥ kandarpasya bhasmakaraṇam, patināśaṃ jñātvā ratyā śokakaraṇam, tataḥ śivājñayā anaṃgībhūtasya kāmasya mahākālavane gamanam, tatra tapastaptvā liṃgasthāpanam, kāmeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanama 89. 2
6.2.d: 13 अथ कामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम, तत्र ब्रह्मणा मुष्टिनिर्मापणार्थं काममुत्पाद्य तस्य द्वादशस्थानानि दत्त्वा शिवोपरि कामोद्दीपनार्थं प्रेषणम्, शिवेन स्वतपसो विघ्नकारिणः कन्दर्पस्य भस्मकरणम्, पतिनाशं ज्ञात्वा रत्या शोककरणम्, ततः शिवाज्ञया अनंगीभूतस्य कामस्य महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा लिंगस्थापनम्, कामेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम 89. 2
6.2.m: 13. Now, the description of the māhātmya of Kāmeśvara: there, Brahmā, having created Kāma to fashion a handful [of creation] and assigned him twelve seats, sent him to arouse desire in Śiva; Śiva reduced to ashes Kandarpa, who had caused an obstacle to his tapas; upon learning of her husband's destruction, Rati's lamentation; then, by Śiva's command, the bodiless Kāma went to the Mahākāla forest; having performed tapas there, he installed a liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Kāmeśvara liṅga. (89.2)

6.2.s: 14 atha kuṭumbakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kṣīrābdhimanthanasamaye nirgataṃ kālakūṭaṃ pītvā tadutthaṃ dāhamasahamānena śaṃkareṇa śiprāyai tasya kālakūṭasya pradānam, tadgṛhītvā śiprāyā mahākālavane gamanam, śiprayā kāmeśvaraliṃgasamīpasthaliṃgopari tasya kālakūṭaviṣasya nikṣepaṇam, kālakūṭaviṣalepanāttaddarśanārthamāgatānāṃ viprāṇāṃ maraṇaprāptivarṇanam, śivena tatrāgatya viprāṇāṃ punarujjīvanakaraṇam, śivena talliṃgasya kuṭuṃvakeśvareti nāmakaraṇam, kuṭuṃbakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... 91 1
6.2.d: 14 अथ कुटुम्बकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र क्षीराब्धिमन्थनसमये निर्गतं कालकूटं पीत्वा तदुत्थं दाहमसहमानेन शंकरेण शिप्रायै तस्य कालकूटस्य प्रदानम्, तद्गृहीत्वा शिप्राया महाकालवने गमनम्, शिप्रया कामेश्वरलिंगसमीपस्थलिंगोपरि तस्य कालकूटविषस्य निक्षेपणम्, कालकूटविषलेपनात्तद्दर्शनार्थमागतानां विप्राणां मरणप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, शिवेन तत्रागत्य विप्राणां पुनरुज्जीवनकरणम्, शिवेन तल्लिंगस्य कुटुंवकेश्वरेति नामकरणम्, कुटुंबकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... 91 1
6.2.m: 14. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kuṭumbakeśvara liṅga: there, at the time of churning the ocean of milk, Śaṃkara, unable to bear the burning sensation arising from having drunk the kālakūṭa poison that emerged, gave that kālakūṭa poison to the Śiprā; having taken it, the Śiprā went to the Mahākāla forest; the Śiprā threw that kālakūṭa poison onto the liṅga situated near the Kāmeśvara liṅga; the description of the brahmins meeting their death after coming for darśana on account of the smeared kālakūṭa poison; Śiva, having arrived there, revived the brahmins; Śiva named that liṅga Kuṭumbakeśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Kuṭumbakeśvara liṅga. (91.1)

6.2.s: 15 athendradyumneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra puṇyabhraṃśādindradyumnasya svargataḥ patanam, paścāttāpenākṣayāṃ kīrtiṃ sampādayituṃ himavannage mārkaṇḍeyadarśanaṃ gṛhītvā tadājñayā mahākālavane gatvā śivaliṃgārcanakaraṇam, tenākṣayāṃ kīrtiṃ labdhvā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, indradyumneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. 91 2
6.2.d: 15 अथेन्द्रद्युम्नेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पुण्यभ्रंशादिन्द्रद्युम्नस्य स्वर्गतः पतनम्, पश्चात्तापेनाक्षयां कीर्तिं सम्पादयितुं हिमवन्नगे मार्कण्डेयदर्शनं गृहीत्वा तदाज्ञया महाकालवने गत्वा शिवलिंगार्चनकरणम्, तेनाक्षयां कीर्तिं लब्ध्वा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, इन्द्रद्युम्नेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. 91 2
6.2.m: 15. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Indradyumneśvara liṅga: there, through the exhaustion of his merit, Indradyumna fell from heaven; out of remorse, wishing to acquire imperishable renown, he received darśana of Mārkaṇḍeya on Mount Himavat, went to the Mahākāla forest by his command, and performed worship of the Śiva liṅga; having thereby attained imperishable renown, he installed a liṅga under his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Indradyumneśvara liṅga. (91.2)

6.2.s: 16 atheśāneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra muṃḍaputreṇa tuhuṇḍena jitairdevaiḥ śivājñayā mahākālavane gatvā śivaliṃgārcanakaraṇam, īśvareṇa prasannena svanāmnā tasya liṃgasyeśāneśvareti nāmakaraṇam, īśāneśvarasya devaiḥ stotrakaraṇam, īśāneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... ..... ....... 92
6.2.d: 16 अथेशानेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मुंडपुत्रेण तुहुण्डेन जितैर्देवैः शिवाज्ञया महाकालवने गत्वा शिवलिंगार्चनकरणम्, ईश्वरेण प्रसन्नेन स्वनाम्ना तस्य लिंगस्येशानेश्वरेति नामकरणम्, ईशानेश्वरस्य देवैः स्तोत्रकरणम्, ईशानेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ..... ....... 92
6.2.m: 16. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Īśāneśvara liṅga: there, the gods, having been defeated by Tuhuṇḍa, son of Muṇḍa, went to the Mahākāla forest by Śiva's command and worshipped the Śiva liṅga; Īśvara, being pleased, named that liṅga Īśāneśvara after his own name; the gods uttered a hymn of praise to Īśāneśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Īśāneśvara liṅga. (92)

6.2.s: 17 athāpsaraseśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śakrasabhāyāṃ nṛtyamānāyā raṃbhāyāstālādibhirvikalatvaṃ prāptaṃ nṛtyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śakreṇa krudhā raṃbhāyai śāpadānam, tayā śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ nāradavacanātsvanāmnā mahākālavane liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya nityapūjanena śivaṃ santoṣya tasmādvaraṃ labdhvā svarlokaṃ prati gamanam, apsaraseśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. 93 1
6.2.d: 17 अथाप्सरसेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शक्रसभायां नृत्यमानाया रंभायास्तालादिभिर्विकलत्वं प्राप्तं नृत्यं दृष्ट्वा शक्रेण क्रुधा रंभायै शापदानम्, तया शापनिवृत्त्यर्थं नारदवचनात्स्वनाम्ना महाकालवने लिंगं संस्थाप्य नित्यपूजनेन शिवं सन्तोष्य तस्माद्वरं लब्ध्वा स्वर्लोकं प्रति गमनम्, अप्सरसेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. 93 1
6.2.m: 17. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Apsaraseśvara liṅga: there, Indra, having seen Rambhā dancing in his assembly and her dance becoming flawed in rhythm and time, cursed Rambhā in anger; in order to remove the curse, by the word of Nārada she installed a liṅga under her own name in the Mahākāla forest, pleased Śiva through daily worship, received a boon from him, and went to heaven; the description of the māhātmya of the Apsaraseśvara liṅga. (93.1)

6.2.s: 18 atha kalakaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatromāmaheśvaravivādaprasaṃge tribhuvane kampite sati tatra sarvataḥ samutpannena kalakaletiśabdena liṃgaprādurbhāvo'tastasya liṃgasya kalakaleti nāmakaraṇam, kalakaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. ... 93 2
6.2.d: 18 अथ कलकलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्रोमामहेश्वरविवादप्रसंगे त्रिभुवने कम्पिते सति तत्र सर्वतः समुत्पन्नेन कलकलेतिशब्देन लिंगप्रादुर्भावोऽतस्तस्य लिंगस्य कलकलेति नामकरणम्, कलकलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. ... 93 2
6.2.m: 18. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kalakaleśvara liṅga: there, on the occasion of a dispute between Umā and Maheśvara, when the three worlds trembled, a liṅga manifested from the tumultuous sound 'kalakala' that arose on all sides, and therefore that liṅga was named Kalakala; the description of the māhātmya of the Kalakaleśvara liṅga. (93.2)

6.2.s: 19 atha nāgacaṃḍeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyayavarṇanam, tatra nāgacaṃḍena sthāpitasya liṃgasya darśanārthaṃ devānāmāgamanam, talliṃgasaṃpūjane nirmālyalaṃghanādidoṣe prāpte tasya nāgacaṇḍeśvaraliṃgasya samīpe liṅgasthāpanam, tena devānāṃ nirmālyalaṃghanādidoṣānnivṛttiḥ, nāgacaṃḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.. .. ... 94
6.2.d: 19 अथ नागचंडेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्ययवर्णनम्, तत्र नागचंडेन स्थापितस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनार्थं देवानामागमनम्, तल्लिंगसंपूजने निर्माल्यलंघनादिदोषे प्राप्ते तस्य नागचण्डेश्वरलिंगस्य समीपे लिङ्गस्थापनम्, तेन देवानां निर्माल्यलंघनादिदोषान्निवृत्तिः, नागचंडेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.. .. ... 94
6.2.m: 19. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Nāgacaṇḍeśvara liṅga: there, the arrival of the gods to obtain darśana of the liṅga installed by Nāgacaṇḍa; when the fault of stepping over discarded offerings and the like occurred in the worship of that liṅga, a liṅga was installed near that Nāgacaṇḍeśvara liṅga; thereby the gods were freed from the fault of stepping over discarded offerings; the description of the māhātmya of the Nāgacaṇḍeśvara liṅga. (94)

6.2.s: 20 atha pratīhāreśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra ramamāṇayorumāmaheśvarayordvāri sthitena pratihāreṇa nandinā'jñātena vahninā'ntaḥpure praveśakaraṇam, tena ruṣṭena śivena nandine śāpapradānam, tena śāpena naṃdinā pṛthivyāṃ mahākālavane gatvā pratihāreśvareti nāmnā śivaliṃgasthāpanam, tatprasādena naṃdinaḥ punaḥ śivalokaṃ prati gamanam, pratihāreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam....... 95 1
6.2.d: 20 अथ प्रतीहारेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र रममाणयोरुमामहेश्वरयोर्द्वारि स्थितेन प्रतिहारेण नन्दिनाऽज्ञातेन वह्निनाऽन्तःपुरे प्रवेशकरणम्, तेन रुष्टेन शिवेन नन्दिने शापप्रदानम्, तेन शापेन नंदिना पृथिव्यां महाकालवने गत्वा प्रतिहारेश्वरेति नाम्ना शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, तत्प्रसादेन नंदिनः पुनः शिवलोकं प्रति गमनम्, प्रतिहारेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्....... 95 1
6.2.m: 20. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Pratīhāreśvara liṅga: there, while Umā and Maheśvara were sporting, Nandin, standing at the door as the doorkeeper, unwittingly allowed Agni to enter the inner chamber; Śiva, angered by this, pronounced a curse upon Nandin; because of that curse, Nandin went down to earth to the Mahākāla forest and installed a Śiva liṅga under the name Pratīhāreśvara; by his grace, Nandin returned to the world of Śiva; the description of the māhātmya of the Pratīhāreśvara liṅga. (95.1)

6.2.s: 21 atha kukkuṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kauśikākhyasya bhūpasya prāgjanmani nityaṃ kukkuṭabhakṣaṇāttāmracūḍadattaśāpena pratiniśi kukkuṭatvaprāptiḥ, tacchāpanāśārthaṃ mahākālavane pakṣiyonivimocanākhyaliṃgapūjanam, tena tasya kukkuṭatvaprāptinivṛttiḥ, kukkuṭeśvaraliṃgasthāpanam, kukkuṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam 95 2
6.2.d: 21 अथ कुक्कुटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कौशिकाख्यस्य भूपस्य प्राग्जन्मनि नित्यं कुक्कुटभक्षणात्ताम्रचूडदत्तशापेन प्रतिनिशि कुक्कुटत्वप्राप्तिः, तच्छापनाशार्थं महाकालवने पक्षियोनिविमोचनाख्यलिंगपूजनम्, तेन तस्य कुक्कुटत्वप्राप्तिनिवृत्तिः, कुक्कुटेश्वरलिंगस्थापनम्, कुक्कुटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 95 2
6.2.m: 21. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kukkuṭeśvara liṅga: there, a king named Kauśika, due to eating roosters daily in a previous birth, acquired the state of a rooster every night by a curse given by a cock; to dispel that curse, he worshipped the liṅga named 'Deliverer from the Womb of Birds' in the Mahākāla forest; thereby his attainment of the state of a rooster ceased; the installation of the Kukkuṭeśvara liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Kukkuṭeśvara liṅga. (95.2)

6.2.s:
22 atha karkaṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra dharmamūrtyākhyanṛpativasiṣṭhasaṃvādaprasaṃgenaiśvaryaprāptikāraṇaṃ jijñāsamānena tena pṛṣṭena vasiṣṭhena 'tava prāgjanmani kṛtena pātakena karkaṭatvaprāptau kenacidvāyasena karkaṭaśarīraṃ dhṛtvā śivāgre pātitaṃ tato'ntakāle
śivadarśanaprabhāvenaitasmiñjanmanyaiśvaryaprāptiḥ' iti vṛttāntakathanam, karkaṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ..... .... ...... .. 97 1
6.2.d:
22 अथ कर्कटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र धर्ममूर्त्याख्यनृपतिवसिष्ठसंवादप्रसंगेनैश्वर्यप्राप्तिकारणं जिज्ञासमानेन तेन पृष्टेन वसिष्ठेन ऽतव प्राग्जन्मनि कृतेन पातकेन कर्कटत्वप्राप्तौ केनचिद्वायसेन कर्कटशरीरं धृत्वा शिवाग्रे पातितं ततोऽन्तकाले
शिवदर्शनप्रभावेनैतस्मिञ्जन्मन्यैश्वर्यप्राप्तिः' इति वृत्तान्तकथनम्, कर्कटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ..... .... ...... .. 97 1
6.2.m: 22. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Karkaṭeśvara liṅga: there, on the occasion of a dialogue between the king named Dharmamūrti and Vasiṣṭha, being asked by the king who was eager to know the cause of his attainment of royal power, Vasiṣṭha related the narrative: 'Due to a wicked deed done by you in a previous birth, when you had attained the state of a crab, a crow seized your crab body and dropped it before Śiva; then, by the power of darśana of Śiva at the time of death, your attainment of royal power occurred in this birth'; the description of the māhātmya of the Karkaṭeśvara liṅga. (97.1)

6.2.s:
23 atha meghanādeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra madāṃdhākhyena rājñā daurjanyādyajñakriyāṇāmakaraṇena bhūtale vṛṣṭyabhāvāddevānāṃ brahmaloke gamanam, tato brahmājñayā devānāṃ mahākālavane gamanam, tatra devairmeghapratiṣṭhāpitaliṅgastavanam, tasya liṃgasya pūjanena vṛṣṭiprāptivarṇanam, atastasya meghasthāpitasya liṃgasya meghanādeśvaretināmaka-
raṇam, meghanādeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam..... .... ... 97 2
6.2.d:
23 अथ मेघनादेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मदांधाख्येन राज्ञा दौर्जन्याद्यज्ञक्रियाणामकरणेन भूतले वृष्ट्यभावाद्देवानां ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, ततो ब्रह्माज्ञया देवानां महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र देवैर्मेघप्रतिष्ठापितलिङ्गस्तवनम्, तस्य लिंगस्य पूजनेन वृष्टिप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, अतस्तस्य मेघस्थापितस्य लिंगस्य मेघनादेश्वरेतिनामक-
रणम्, मेघनादेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्..... .... ... 97 2
6.2.m: 23. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Meghanādeśvara liṅga: there, because a king named Madāndha through wickedness did not perform sacrificial rites, there was an absence of rain on the earth, and the gods went to the world of Brahmā; then, by Brahmā's command, the gods went to the Mahākāla forest; there the gods praised the liṅga installed by a cloud; the description of the obtaining of rain through the worship of that liṅga; therefore that liṅga installed by a cloud was named Meghanādeśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Meghanādeśvara liṅga. (97.2)
24. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Mahālayeśvara liṅga. (98.2)

6.2.s:
25 atha muktīśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra mahākālasamīpasthe muktiliṃge trayodaśavarṣaparyaṃtaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyato muktināmakaviprasyāgre'kasmātkasyacidvyādhasyāgamanam,
vipradarśanena liṃgadarśanena ca vyādhasya daurjanyaṃ gatvā sauṣṭhavaprāptivarṇanam, vyādhena jale sthitvā tapaścaraṇam, aṣṭākṣaramaṃtrajapena tasya muktiḥ, tatsthāne prāptasya kasyacidvyāghrasyāpi tanmaṃtraśravaṇena mokṣavarṇanam, vyāghreṇa pūrvajanmakathānakakathanapūrvakamātmanaḥ śāpakāraṇakathanama, tayorvyāghra-muktidvijayormahākālavane gamanam, tatra liṃgasthāpanam, muktīśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanamama, ...... 95 1
6.2.d:
25 अथ मुक्तीश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र महाकालसमीपस्थे मुक्तिलिंगे त्रयोदशवर्षपर्यंतं नारायणं ध्यायतो मुक्तिनामकविप्रस्याग्रेऽकस्मात्कस्यचिद्व्याधस्यागमनम्,
विप्रदर्शनेन लिंगदर्शनेन च व्याधस्य दौर्जन्यं गत्वा सौष्ठवप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, व्याधेन जले स्थित्वा तपश्चरणम्, अष्टाक्षरमंत्रजपेन तस्य मुक्तिः, तत्स्थाने प्राप्तस्य कस्यचिद्व्याघ्रस्यापि तन्मंत्रश्रवणेन मोक्षवर्णनम्, व्याघ्रेण पूर्वजन्मकथानककथनपूर्वकमात्मनः शापकारणकथनम, तयोर्व्याघ्र-मुक्तिद्विजयोर्महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र लिंगस्थापनम्, मुक्तीश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनमम, ...... 95 1
6.2.m: 25. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Muktīśvara liṅga: There, before a brahmin named Mukti who was meditating upon Nārāyaṇa for thirteen years at the Muktiliṅga near Mahākāla, a hunter suddenly arrived; the description of how, by the darśana of the brahmin and the darśana of the liṅga, the hunter's wickedness vanished and he attained excellence; the hunter's performance of austerity while standing in water; his liberation through reciting the eight-syllable mantra; the description of the liberation of a tiger that arrived at that place also through hearing that mantra; the tiger's statement of the reason for his curse preceded by the narration of his previous birth; the departure of both the tiger and the twice-born Mukti to the Mahākālavana; the installation of a liṅga there; the description of the māhātmya of the Muktīśvara liṅga. ... 95.1

6.2.s: 26 atha someśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra rohiṇīṃ vinā'nyāsu candrasyāprītiṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhena dakṣeṇa dattasya śāpasya nivṛttyarthaṃ somasya satyaloke gamanam, tena brahmaṇā saha vaikuṃṭhaṃ gatvā viṣṇoḥstavakaraṇam, vipṇvājñayā somasya mahākālavane gamanam, tatra liṃgasthāpanam, tena somasya yakṣmarogaśāntivarṇanam, someśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam..... .. .. 100
6.2.d: 26 अथ सोमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र रोहिणीं विनाऽन्यासु चन्द्रस्याप्रीतिं दृष्ट्वा क्रोधेन दक्षेण दत्तस्य शापस्य निवृत्त्यर्थं सोमस्य सत्यलोके गमनम्, तेन ब्रह्मणा सह वैकुंठं गत्वा विष्णोःस्तवकरणम्, विप्ण्वाज्ञया सोमस्य महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र लिंगस्थापनम्, तेन सोमस्य यक्ष्मरोगशान्तिवर्णनम्, सोमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्..... .. .. 100
6.2.m: 26. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Someśvara liṅga: There, Soma's departure to Satyaloka for the removal of the curse given in anger by Dakṣa upon seeing [Soma's] lack of love for his other [wives] except Rohiṇī; his going to Vaikuṇṭha with Brahmā and offering praise to Viṣṇu; Soma's departure to the Mahākālavana by Viṣṇu's command; the installation of a liṅga there; the description of the alleviation of Soma's pulmonary consumption by means of that; the description of the māhātmya of the Someśvara liṅga. ... 100

6.2.s: 27 athānarakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra narakayātanākramavarṇanapuraḥsaraṃ niminā puṇyabāhulye'pi kiñcitpāpena yamalokagamanam, punaranarakeśvaradarśanena sarvapāpakṣaye jāte vimānamāruhyendraloke gamanam, yamayātanopabhogakāriṇā prāṇināṃ duḥkhena duḥkhitasya nimeryamakṛtaṃ sānvanam, anarakeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... 102 1
6.2.d: 27 अथानरकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र नरकयातनाक्रमवर्णनपुरःसरं निमिना पुण्यबाहुल्येऽपि किञ्चित्पापेन यमलोकगमनम्, पुनरनरकेश्वरदर्शनेन सर्वपापक्षये जाते विमानमारुह्येन्द्रलोके गमनम्, यमयातनोपभोगकारिणा प्राणिनां दुःखेन दुःखितस्य निमेर्यमकृतं सान्वनम्, अनरकेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... 102 1
6.2.m: 27. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Anarakeśvara liṅga: There, preceded by the description of the sequence of the torments of hell, Nimi's departure to the world of Yama on account of a slight sin despite an abundance of merit; his ascending an aerial chariot and going to the world of Indra when all his sins were destroyed by the darśana of Anarakeśvara; the consolation given by Yama to Nimi, who was grieved by the suffering of living beings experiencing the torments of Yama; the description of the māhātmya of the Anarakeśvara liṅga. ... 102.1

6.2.s: 28 atha jaṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanama, tatra vīradhanvano rājñaḥ kathākathanapūrvakaṃ jaṭeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, jaṭeśvaraliṃgasthāpanādivarṇanam.. .. ... 104 1
6.2.d: 28 अथ जटेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम, तत्र वीरधन्वनो राज्ञः कथाकथनपूर्वकं जटेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, जटेश्वरलिंगस्थापनादिवर्णनम्.. .. ... 104 1
6.2.m: 28. Now begins the description of the Jaṭeśvara māhātmya: There, the description of the Jaṭeśvara māhātmya preceded by the narration of the story of King Vīradhanvan; the description of the installation and worship of the Jaṭeśvara liṅga. ... 104.1

6.2.s: 29 atha rāmeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatraikaviṃśativārānniḥkṣatriyāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā śatruhatyādoṣanibarhaṇārthaṃ nānātīrthakṣetrāṇi bhrāntvā doṣābhāvamadṛṣṭvā nāradopadeśājjāmadagne rāmasya mahākālavane jaṭeśvarasamīpe gamanam, tatra tapastaptvā doṣanāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, rāmeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... -. 105 2
6.2.d: 29 अथ रामेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्रैकविंशतिवारान्निःक्षत्रियां पृथिवीं कृत्वा शत्रुहत्यादोषनिबर्हणार्थं नानातीर्थक्षेत्राणि भ्रान्त्वा दोषाभावमदृष्ट्वा नारदोपदेशाज्जामदग्ने रामस्य महाकालवने जटेश्वरसमीपे गमनम्, तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा दोषनाशं दृष्ट्वा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, रामेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... -. 105 2
6.2.m: 29. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Rāmeśvara liṅga: There, having made the earth devoid of kṣatriyas twenty-one times, wandering through various tīrthas and sacred fields to remove the guilt of slaying enemies, and seeing no disappearance of the guilt, Rāma, the son of Jamadagni, on the advice of Nārada, went to the vicinity of Jaṭeśvara in the Mahākālavana; having performed austerity there and seeing the destruction of the guilt, the installation of a liṅga in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Rāmeśvara liṅga. ... 105.2

6.2.s: 30 atha cyavaneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra cyavananāmakarṣiṇā śaryātirājakanyāṃ vṛtvā tato mahākālavane tapastaptvā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, cyavaneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- . ... 106 2
6.2.d: 30 अथ च्यवनेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र च्यवननामकर्षिणा शर्यातिराजकन्यां वृत्वा ततो महाकालवने तपस्तप्त्वा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, च्यवनेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- . ... 106 2
6.2.m: 30. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Cyavaneśvara liṅga: There, the seer named Cyavana, having chosen the daughter of King Śaryāti [as wife], then performed austerity in the Mahākālavana and installed a liṅga in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Cyavaneśvara liṅga. ... 106.2

6.2.s:
31 atha khaṇḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra priyavrataputrasya bhadrāśvarājasya kuṃbhayoni-
vacanānmahākālavane gamanam, tatra khaṇḍitavratapūrṇatāyai liṃgasthāpanam, khaṇḍeśva-
raliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam..... -. ........ 108 1
6.2.d:
31 अथ खण्डेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र प्रियव्रतपुत्रस्य भद्राश्वराजस्य कुंभयोनि-
वचनान्महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र खण्डितव्रतपूर्णतायै लिंगस्थापनम्, खण्डेश्व-
रलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्..... -. ........ 108 1
6.2.m: 31. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Khaṇḍeśvara liṅga: There, King Bhadrāśva, son of Priyavrata, went to the Mahākālavana on the instruction of Agastya (the pitcher-born); the installation of a liṅga there for the completion of broken vows; the description of the māhātmya of the Khaṇḍeśvara liṅga. ... 108.1
32. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Pattaneśvara liṅga. ... 108.2

6.2.s: 33 athānandeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatrānamitrasutenānaṃdena kenacitkāraṇena mahākālavane gatvā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanama, ānaṃdeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... 109 2
6.2.d: 33 अथानन्देश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्रानमित्रसुतेनानंदेन केनचित्कारणेन महाकालवने गत्वा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम, आनंदेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... 109 2
6.2.m: 33. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Ānandeśvara liṅga: There, Ānanda, son of Anamitra, went to the Mahākālavana for a certain reason and installed a liṅga in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Ānandeśvara liṅga. ... 109.2

6.2.s: 34 atha kaṃthaḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra pāṇḍavanāmakabrāhmaṇasya kanthānimittakaṃ tapastaptvā kanthānāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, kanthaḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.... 110 1
6.2.d: 34 अथ कंथडेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पाण्डवनामकब्राह्मणस्य कन्थानिमित्तकं तपस्तप्त्वा कन्थानाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, कन्थडेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... 110 1
6.2.m: 34. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Kanthaḍeśvara liṅga: There, a brahmin named Pāṇḍava, having performed austerity for the sake of a patched garment, installed a liṅga named after the patched garment; the description of the māhātmya of the Kanthaḍeśvara liṅga. ... 110.1

6.2.s: 35 athendreśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra brahmaputrasya kuśadhvajasya svargataḥ pātanātkruddhena brahmaṇā svajaṭāmutpāṭya bhūmau pātanādvṛtrāsurotpattistato vṛtrāsurendrayoryuddha indrasya parābhavaḥ, vṛtraṃ jetuṃ bṛhaspaterājñayā śakrasya mahākālavane gamanam, tapaḥprabhāvena vṛtrāsuraṃ hatvā taddhatyādoṣanivṛttaye tatra liṃgasthāpanam, indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam 111 1
6.2.d: 35 अथेन्द्रेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र ब्रह्मपुत्रस्य कुशध्वजस्य स्वर्गतः पातनात्क्रुद्धेन ब्रह्मणा स्वजटामुत्पाट्य भूमौ पातनाद्वृत्रासुरोत्पत्तिस्ततो वृत्रासुरेन्द्रयोर्युद्ध इन्द्रस्य पराभवः, वृत्रं जेतुं बृहस्पतेराज्ञया शक्रस्य महाकालवने गमनम्, तपःप्रभावेन वृत्रासुरं हत्वा तद्धत्यादोषनिवृत्तये तत्र लिंगस्थापनम्, इन्द्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 111 1
6.2.m: 35. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Indreśvara liṅga: There, because Kuśadhvaja, the son of Brahmā, was cast down from heaven, Brahmā, enraged, tore out his own matted hair and cast it on the ground, whence arose Vṛtrāsura; then in a battle between Vṛtrāsura and Indra, Indra was defeated; Śakra's departure to the Mahākālavana by the command of Bṛhaspati to conquer Vṛtra; having slain Vṛtrāsura by the power of austerity, the installation of a liṅga there for the removal of the sin of slaying him; the description of the Indreśvara māhātmya. 111.1

6.2.s: 36 atha mārkaṇḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra mārkaṇḍeyajanmakathāvarṇanapūrvakaṃ mahākālavane mārkaṇḍeyena svanāmnā liṅgasthāpanama, mārkaṃḍeyeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- 112 1
6.2.d: 36 अथ मार्कण्डेयेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मार्कण्डेयजन्मकथावर्णनपूर्वकं महाकालवने मार्कण्डेयेन स्वनाम्ना लिङ्गस्थापनम, मार्कंडेयेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- 112 1
6.2.m: 36. Now begins the description of the Mārkaṇḍeyeśvara māhātmya: There, preceded by the narration of the story of Mārkaṇḍeya's birth, the installation of a liṅga in his own name by Mārkaṇḍeya in the Mahākālavana; the description of the māhātmya of the Mārkaṇḍeyeśvara liṅga. 112.1
37. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Śiveśvara liṅga: There, the description of the story of Ripuñjaya; the description of the Śiveśvara māhātmya. ... 113.1

6.2.d:
38 अथ कुसुमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कुसुमक्रीडाविहारत्वात्कुसुमेश्वरेतिनामकर-
णम्, कुसुमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ....... .. ... 114 1
6.2.m: 38. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Kusumeśvara liṅga: There, because of it being a place of sporting with flowers, it was given the name Kusumeśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Kusumeśvara liṅga. ... 114.1

6.2.s: 39 athākrūreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra bhṛṃgiriṭṭinā nijakrūrabuddhivināśāya mahākālavane liṃgaṃ sthāpayitvā tasya pūjākaraṇam, tena tasya kūrabhāvanivṛttiḥ, tasya liṃgasyākrūreśvaranāmnā prasiddhiḥ, akrūreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... .. 115 1
6.2.d: 39 अथाक्रूरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र भृंगिरिट्टिना निजक्रूरबुद्धिविनाशाय महाकालवने लिंगं स्थापयित्वा तस्य पूजाकरणम्, तेन तस्य कूरभावनिवृत्तिः, तस्य लिंगस्याक्रूरेश्वरनाम्ना प्रसिद्धिः, अक्रूरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... .. 115 1
6.2.m: 39. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Akrūreśvara liṅga: There, Bhṛṅgiriṭin installed a liṅga and worshipped it in the Mahākālavana for the destruction of his cruel disposition; by that, his cruel disposition ceased; the fame of that liṅga by the name Akrūreśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Akrūreśvara liṅga. ... 115.1

6.2.s:
40 atha kuṇḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śivapārvatyorvṛṣārūḍhayormārge kenacinnimittena śivāntardhānaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatyā śivadarśanotsukayā'ntarvighnakāriṇaṃ kuṇḍanāma-kagaṇaṃ prati śāpadānam, tena kuṇḍena śāpanivṛttyartha mahākālavane svanāmnā liṃga-
sthāpanam, kuṇḍeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- -... - ... 116 1
6.2.d:
40 अथ कुण्डेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शिवपार्वत्योर्वृषारूढयोर्मार्गे केनचिन्निमित्तेन शिवान्तर्धानं दृष्ट्वा पार्वत्या शिवदर्शनोत्सुकयाऽन्तर्विघ्नकारिणं कुण्डनाम-कगणं प्रति शापदानम्, तेन कुण्डेन शापनिवृत्त्यर्थ महाकालवने स्वनाम्ना लिंग-
स्थापनम्, कुण्डेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- -... - ... 116 1
6.2.m: 40. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Kuṇḍeśvara liṅga: There, while Śiva and Pārvatī were mounted on the bull along the road, seeing Śiva disappear for some reason, Pārvatī, eager for the darśana of Śiva, gave a curse to the gaṇa named Kuṇḍa who had caused an internal obstacle; the installation of a liṅga by that Kuṇḍa in his own name in the Mahākālavana for the removal of the curse; the description of the māhātmya of the Kuṇḍeśvara liṅga. ... 116.1

6.2.s: 41 atha lumpeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra sāmagabrāhmaṇavadhāttatputradattaśāpena kuṣṭhitvaṃ prāptena luṃparājena nāradopadeśānmahākālavane gamanam, tatra kuṣṭhanāśanāya liṃgasthāpanam, saikateśvarāparanāmno lumpeśvarasya liṃgasya māhātmyavarṇanam .. 117 1
6.2.d: 41 अथ लुम्पेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र सामगब्राह्मणवधात्तत्पुत्रदत्तशापेन कुष्ठित्वं प्राप्तेन लुंपराजेन नारदोपदेशान्महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र कुष्ठनाशनाय लिंगस्थापनम्, सैकतेश्वरापरनाम्नो लुम्पेश्वरस्य लिंगस्य माहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. 117 1
6.2.m: 41. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Lumpeśvara liṅga: There, King Lumpa, who had contracted leprosy because of a curse given by the son of a Sāmaveda-chanting brahmin whom he had killed, went to the Mahākālavana on the advice of Nārada; the installation of a liṅga there for the destruction of leprosy; the description of the māhātmya of the Lumpeśvara liṅga, whose other name is Saikateśvara. ... 117.1

6.2.s: 42 atha gaṅgeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śivajaṭājūṭato bhūmyāṃ gaṅgāprapātena śiprātaṭe gaṅgeśvaretināmnā bhagīrathasthāpitaliṃgamāhātmyam, gaṅgeśvarapūjanādividhimāhātmyavarṇanam -.. -. -.. -. -. ... -.. 117 2
6.2.d: 42 अथ गङ्गेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शिवजटाजूटतो भूम्यां गङ्गाप्रपातेन शिप्रातटे गङ्गेश्वरेतिनाम्ना भगीरथस्थापितलिंगमाहात्म्यम्, गङ्गेश्वरपूजनादिविधिमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् -.. -. -.. -. -. ... -.. 117 2
6.2.m: 42. Now begins the description of the māhātmya of the Gaṅgeśvara liṅga: There, on account of the descent of the Gaṅgā from the matted hair of Śiva to the earth, the māhātmya of the liṅga installed on the bank of the Śiprā by Bhagīratha under the name Gaṅgeśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the rules of worshipping Gaṅgeśvara and so forth. ... 117.2

43. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Aṅgārakeśvara liṅga: therein, the description of the birth of the son Aṅgāraka from the body of Śiva; the description of the māhātmya of Aṅgārakeśvara. 118 2

6.2.s: 44 athottareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra navagrahapīḍitānāmiṃdrādīnāṃ śivādeśācchiprāyāṃ gamanam, uttarameghakṛtaṃ śivaliṃgasthāpanam, uttareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam 119
6.2.d: 44 अथोत्तरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र नवग्रहपीडितानामिंद्रादीनां शिवादेशाच्छिप्रायां गमनम्, उत्तरमेघकृतं शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, उत्तरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 119
6.2.m: 44. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Uttareśvara liṅga: therein, the departure to the Śiprā of Indra and others afflicted by the nine planets by command of Śiva; the installation of the Śiva-liṅga performed by the Uttara cloud; the description of the māhātmya of the Uttareśvara liṅga. 119
45. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Trilocaneśvara liṅga. 121 1
46. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Vīreśvara liṅga. 124 1
47. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Nūpureśvara liṅga. 127 2
48. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Abhayeśvara liṅga. 128 5
49. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Pṛthukeśvara liṅga. 129 1
50. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Sthāvareśvara liṅga. 130 1

6.2.s: 51 atha śūleśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra devyāṃ'dhakāsurasya śūlena nāśaṃ vidhāya śūlanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, śūleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... .. . 131 1
6.2.d: 51 अथ शूलेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र देव्यांऽधकासुरस्य शूलेन नाशं विधाय शूलनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, शूलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... .. . 131 1
6.2.m: 51. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Śūleśvara liṅga: therein, the Goddess's killing of the demon Andhaka with a trident and installation of a liṅga named after the trident; the description of the māhātmya of the Śūleśvara liṅga. 131 1

52. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Oṃkāreśvara liṅga: therein, the description of the māhātmya of the Oṃkāreśvara liṅga installed by the syllable Oṃ issuing from the mouth of Śiva, at Śiva's word. 132 1

6.2.s: 53 atha viśveśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ,tatra vidūrathasya rājño brahmavadhajanitadoṣeṇa duṣṭadvādaśajanmāni gṛhītvā trayodaśe caṇḍālatvaṃ prāpya śivasaṃnidhau mṛtatvādviśveśanāmnā punā rājakule samutpattivarṇanam, pūrvajanmani saṃsmṛtya mahākālavane tena liṃgasthāpanam, viśveśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam-......,.. 132 2
6.2.d: 53 अथ विश्वेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ,तत्र विदूरथस्य राज्ञो ब्रह्मवधजनितदोषेण दुष्टद्वादशजन्मानि गृहीत्वा त्रयोदशे चण्डालत्वं प्राप्य शिवसंनिधौ मृतत्वाद्विश्वेशनाम्ना पुना राजकुले समुत्पत्तिवर्णनम्, पूर्वजन्मनि संस्मृत्य महाकालवने तेन लिंगस्थापनम्, विश्वेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्-......,.. 132 2
6.2.m: 53. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Viśveśvara liṅga: therein, because of the fault born of slaying a brahmin, King Vidūratha took twelve wicked births, became an outcaste in the thirteenth, and having died in the presence of Śiva, the description of his rebirth into a royal family by the name of Viśveśa; remembering his previous life, the installation of a liṅga by him in the Mahākāla forest; the description of the māhātmya of the Viśveśvara liṅga. 132 2

6.2.s: 54 atha kaṃṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kasyacicchatrubhiḥ parājitasya rājño vasiṣṭhāśrame gamanam, tasya vacanānmahākālavane gatvā rājñā liṃgasthāpanapūrvakaṃ pūjākaraṇam, tena niṣkaṃṭakarājyaprāptirataḥ kaṃṭeśvaranāmnā tasya liṅgasya prasiddhiḥ, kaṃṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam... ........ 133 2
6.2.d: 54 अथ कंटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कस्यचिच्छत्रुभिः पराजितस्य राज्ञो वसिष्ठाश्रमे गमनम्, तस्य वचनान्महाकालवने गत्वा राज्ञा लिंगस्थापनपूर्वकं पूजाकरणम्, तेन निष्कंटकराज्यप्राप्तिरतः कंटेश्वरनाम्ना तस्य लिङ्गस्य प्रसिद्धिः, कंटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ........ 133 2
6.2.m: 54. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kaṇṭeśvara liṅga: therein, the going of a certain king defeated by his enemies to the hermitage of Vasiṣṭha; at his word, the king's going to the Mahākāla forest and performing worship after installing a liṅga; thereby, the attainment of a thornless kingdom, hence the renown of that liṅga by the name of Kaṇṭeśvara; the description of the māhātmya of the Kaṇṭeśvara liṅga. 133 2

6.2.s: 55 atha siṃheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śivaprāptyarthaṃ gauryā tapasi kriyamāṇe brahmaṇa āgamanam, brahmavacanātkuddhāyā devyā mukhataḥ siṃhasyotpattistatpoṣārthaṃ devyāḥ stanābhyāṃ dugdhasrāvavarṇanam, pārvatyājñayā siṃhasya mahākālavane gamanam, tasya gaurīvāhanatvaprāptivarṇanam, tena siṃhena svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, siṃheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ...... .. 135 1
6.2.d: 55 अथ सिंहेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शिवप्राप्त्यर्थं गौर्या तपसि क्रियमाणे ब्रह्मण आगमनम्, ब्रह्मवचनात्कुद्धाया देव्या मुखतः सिंहस्योत्पत्तिस्तत्पोषार्थं देव्याः स्तनाभ्यां दुग्धस्राववर्णनम्, पार्वत्याज्ञया सिंहस्य महाकालवने गमनम्, तस्य गौरीवाहनत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, तेन सिंहेन स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, सिंहेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ...... .. 135 1
6.2.m: 55. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Siṃheśvara liṅga: therein, while austerity was being performed by Gaurī to attain Śiva, the arrival of Brahmā; from the speech of Brahmā, the birth of a lion from the mouth of the enraged Goddess; for its nourishment, the description of milk flowing from the Goddess's breasts; by Pārvatī's command, the lion's going to the Mahākāla forest; the description of his becoming Gaurī's mount; the installation of a liṅga by that lion in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Siṃheśvara liṅga. 135 1

6.2.s: 56 atha revaṃteśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam ,tatra sūryaputreṇa revaṃtena devāñjitvā kailāse gamanam, śivavacanena mahākālavanamāgatya tatra svanāmnā śivaliṃgasthāpanam, revaṃteśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.... ...... .... 135 2
6.2.d: 56 अथ रेवंतेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ,तत्र सूर्यपुत्रेण रेवंतेन देवाञ्जित्वा कैलासे गमनम्, शिववचनेन महाकालवनमागत्य तत्र स्वनाम्ना शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, रेवंतेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... ...... .... 135 2
6.2.m: 56. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Revanteśvara liṅga: therein, Revanta, the son of the Sun, having conquered the gods, went to Kailāsa; at the word of Śiva, having come to the Mahākāla forest, he installed a Śiva-liṅga there in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Revanteśvara liṅga. 135 2

6.2.s: 57 atha ghaṇṭeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śaivagaṇena ghaṃṭena śivaṃ tyaktvā svagāyanakauśalaṃ darśayituṃ brahmaloke gamanam, nāradena tatra gataṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā śivāya kathanam, tena ruṣṭena śivena ghaṃṭākhyagaṇāya śāpadānam, tacchāpanivṛttyai nāradādeśānmahākālavanaṃ gatvā śivaliṃgasthāpanam, ghaṃṭeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ...... 136 2
6.2.d: 57 अथ घण्टेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शैवगणेन घंटेन शिवं त्यक्त्वा स्वगायनकौशलं दर्शयितुं ब्रह्मलोके गमनम्, नारदेन तत्र गतं तं दृष्ट्वा शिवाय कथनम्, तेन रुष्टेन शिवेन घंटाख्यगणाय शापदानम्, तच्छापनिवृत्त्यै नारदादेशान्महाकालवनं गत्वा शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, घंटेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ...... 136 2
6.2.m: 57. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Ghaṇṭeśvara liṅga: therein, the Śaiva attendant Ghaṇṭa abandoned Śiva and went to the world of Brahmā to demonstrate his singing skill; Nārada, seeing him gone there, told Śiva; angered thereby, Śiva uttered a curse upon the attendant named Ghaṇṭa; to be freed from that curse, at Nārada's instruction, he went to the Mahākāla forest and installed a Śiva-liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Ghaṇṭeśvara liṅga. 136 2

6.2.s: 58 atha prayāgeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra priyavratanāradasaṃvāde nāradasya sāvitryā darśanam, sāvitrīdarśanena nāradasya vedanāśaḥ, taddṛṣṭvā''ścaryeṇa pṛṣṭayā sāvitryā sarvavṛttakathanam, sāvitrīvacanānnāradasya prayāgagamane niṣṭhāprāpaṇam, priyavratena samaṃ nāradasyāvantīsthaprayāge gamanam, tatra gatvā liṃgasya sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca, prayāgeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.. ... - .. .. ... 137 2
6.2.d: 58 अथ प्रयागेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र प्रियव्रतनारदसंवादे नारदस्य सावित्र्या दर्शनम्, सावित्रीदर्शनेन नारदस्य वेदनाशः, तद्दृष्ट्वा'ऽश्चर्येण पृष्टया सावित्र्या सर्ववृत्तकथनम्, सावित्रीवचनान्नारदस्य प्रयागगमने निष्ठाप्रापणम्, प्रियव्रतेन समं नारदस्यावन्तीस्थप्रयागे गमनम्, तत्र गत्वा लिंगस्य स्थापनं पूजनं च, प्रयागेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.. ... - .. .. ... 137 2
6.2.m: 58. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Prayāgeśvara liṅga: therein, in the conversation between Priyavrata and Nārada, Nārada's darśana of Sāvitrī; by the sight of Sāvitrī, Nārada's loss of the Vedas; seeing that, Sāvitrī, questioned in amazement, recounted the entire event; from Sāvitrī's word, Nārada's acquiring resolve to go to Prayāga; Nārada's journey with Priyavrata to the Prayāga situated in Avantī; having gone there, the installation and worship of the liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Prayāgeśvara liṅga. 137 2

6.2.s: 59 atha siddheśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatrāśvaśiraso rājño jaigīṣavyakapilamahāmunyordarśanam, tābhyāṃ darśitayā māyayā bhagavatsvarūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā āścaryeṇa śaraṇagamanam, tayorājñayā tena rājñā mahākālavane gatvā siddhiprāptyarthaṃ liṃgapūjanam, siddheśvara liṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ..... ............ 138 2
6.2.d: 59 अथ सिद्धेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्राश्वशिरसो राज्ञो जैगीषव्यकपिलमहामुन्योर्दर्शनम्, ताभ्यां दर्शितया मायया भगवत्स्वरूपं दृष्ट्वा आश्चर्येण शरणगमनम्, तयोराज्ञया तेन राज्ञा महाकालवने गत्वा सिद्धिप्राप्त्यर्थं लिंगपूजनम्, सिद्धेश्वर लिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ..... ............ 138 2
6.2.m: 59. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Siddheśvara liṅga: therein, King Aśvaśiras had a darśana of the great sages Jaigīṣavya and Kapila; having seen the nature of the Lord through the māyā shown by the two, he took refuge in amazement; at their command, that king went to the Mahākāla forest and worshipped the liṅga to attain perfection; the description of the māhātmya of the Siddheśvara liṅga. 138 2

6.2.s: 60 atha mataṃgeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra sugativipraputreṇa mataṃgena liṃgasya sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca, mataṃgeśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam - -. ........ 139 2
6.2.d: 60 अथ मतंगेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र सुगतिविप्रपुत्रेण मतंगेन लिंगस्य स्थापनं पूजनं च, मतंगेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - -. ........ 139 2
6.2.m: 60. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Mataṅgeśvara liṅga: therein, the installation and worship of the liṅga by Mataṅga, son of the brahmin Sugati; the description of the māhātmya of the Mataṅgeśvara liṅga. 139 2

6.2.s: 61 atha saubhāgyeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatrāśvavāhananṛpabhāryayā sumatyā pativiyogādatiduḥkhitayā nijapatiprāptyarthamṛṣyādeśālliṃgapūjanam, tatprasādāttasyāḥ patyurāgamanena saubhāgyaprāptiḥ, saubhāgyeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam..... 140 2
6.2.d: 61 अथ सौभाग्येश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्राश्ववाहननृपभार्यया सुमत्या पतिवियोगादतिदुःखितया निजपतिप्राप्त्यर्थमृष्यादेशाल्लिंगपूजनम्, तत्प्रसादात्तस्याः पत्युरागमनेन सौभाग्यप्राप्तिः, सौभाग्येश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्..... 140 2
6.2.m: 61. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Saubhāgyeśvara liṅga: therein, King Aśvavāhana's wife Sumatī, intensely distressed by separation from her husband, worshipped a liṅga by order of a seer to regain her husband; by its grace, through the return of her husband, she attained marital auspiciousness; the description of the māhātmya of the Saubhāgyeśvara liṅga. 140 2

6.2.s: 62 atha rūpeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra padmarājasya kaṇvāśrame gamanam, tatra tena kaṇvamadṛṣṭvā tatkanyāyā darśanam, kāmamohitena tena tayā saha vyabhicaraṇam, tatkaṇvena jñānacakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā tayoḥ kurūpabhavanarūpaśāpapradānam, .tataḥ kaṇvājñayā tayormahākālavane gamanam, tatra liṃgapūjanena susvarūpaprāptivarṇanam, rūpeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam........ ... ... 142 1
6.2.d: 62 अथ रूपेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पद्मराजस्य कण्वाश्रमे गमनम्, तत्र तेन कण्वमदृष्ट्वा तत्कन्याया दर्शनम्, काममोहितेन तेन तया सह व्यभिचरणम्, तत्कण्वेन ज्ञानचक्षुषा दृष्ट्वा तयोः कुरूपभवनरूपशापप्रदानम्, .ततः कण्वाज्ञया तयोर्महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र लिंगपूजनेन सुस्वरूपप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, रूपेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्........ ... ... 142 1
6.2.m: 62. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Rūpeśvara liṅga: therein, King Padma went to the hermitage of Kaṇva; not seeing Kaṇva there, he saw his daughter; infatuated with desire, he committed misconduct with her; Kaṇva, seeing that with the eye of knowledge, bestowed a curse upon the two that they become deformed; then, by Kaṇva's command, they went to the Mahākāla forest; therein, through worship of the liṅga, the description of their regaining beautiful form; the description of the māhātmya of the Rūpeśvara liṅga. 142 1

6.2.s: 63 atha dhanuḥsāhasreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra vidūratharājasya kanyāyāḥ kusuṃbhadaityena haraṇam, tato vidūrathaputrābhyāṃ sākaṃ tasya daityasya yuddham, tatra rājñā vidūrathena svaputrayoḥ parābhavaṃ bandhanatvaprāptiṃ ca jñātvā tatparājayārthamṛṣyanujñayā mahākālavanaṃ gatvā liṃgapūjanam, tena pūjanaprabhāveṇa tasya dhanuḥsahasratulyadhanuṣyaprāptiḥ, tena dhanuḥsahāyena daityasya parābhavaḥ, tasya rājñaḥ putrakanyādisahitasya sukhaprāptipūrvakamante mokṣaprāptivarṇanam, dhanuḥsāhasreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- .. ... ... ... ... 143 1
6.2.d: 63 अथ धनुःसाहस्रेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र विदूरथराजस्य कन्यायाः कुसुंभदैत्येन हरणम्, ततो विदूरथपुत्राभ्यां साकं तस्य दैत्यस्य युद्धम्, तत्र राज्ञा विदूरथेन स्वपुत्रयोः पराभवं बन्धनत्वप्राप्तिं च ज्ञात्वा तत्पराजयार्थमृष्यनुज्ञया महाकालवनं गत्वा लिंगपूजनम्, तेन पूजनप्रभावेण तस्य धनुःसहस्रतुल्यधनुष्यप्राप्तिः, तेन धनुःसहायेन दैत्यस्य पराभवः, तस्य राज्ञः पुत्रकन्यादिसहितस्य सुखप्राप्तिपूर्वकमन्ते मोक्षप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, धनुःसाहस्रेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- .. ... ... ... ... 143 1
6.2.m: 63. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Dhanuḥsāhasreśvara liṅga: Therein, the abduction of King Vidūratha's daughter by the daitya Kusumbha; then the battle of that daitya with Vidūratha's two sons; therein, King Vidūratha, learning of the defeat and captivity of his two sons, goes to the Mahākāla forest by a sage's permission to defeat him and worships the liṅga; by the power of that worship, his attainment of a bow equal to a thousand bows; with the help of that bow, the defeat of the daitya; the description of that king, together with his sons and daughter, first attaining happiness and in the end attaining liberation; the description of the māhātmya of the Dhanuḥsāhasreśvara liṅga. (143.1)

6.2.s: 64 atha paśupatīśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra paśupālarājena liṃgamya sthāpanam, tasya pūjanaṃ ca, paśupatīśvaraliṃgasya māhātmyavarṇanam .. 144 1
6.2.d: 64 अथ पशुपतीश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पशुपालराजेन लिंगम्य स्थापनम्, तस्य पूजनं च, पशुपतीश्वरलिंगस्य माहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. 144 1
6.2.m: 64. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Paśupatīśvara liṅga: Therein, the installation of the liṅga and its worship by King Paśupāla; the description of the māhātmya of the Paśupatīśvara liṅga. (144.1)

6.2.s: 65 atha brahmeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra pulomadaityena mvasainyena saha vipṇuṃ jetuṃ kṣīrābdhau gamanam, taddṛṣṭvā brahmaṇo daityajayārthaṃ mahākālavane gamanam, tatra tapastaptvā prasannena śivena daityaparājayakaraṇavarṇanam, brahmaṇā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, brahmeśvaraliṃgasya māhātmyavarṇanam.-........ -..... 145 5
6.2.d: 65 अथ ब्रह्मेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पुलोमदैत्येन म्वसैन्येन सह विप्णुं जेतुं क्षीराब्धौ गमनम्, तद्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मणो दैत्यजयार्थं महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र तपस्तप्त्वा प्रसन्नेन शिवेन दैत्यपराजयकरणवर्णनम्, ब्रह्मणा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, ब्रह्मेश्वरलिंगस्य माहात्म्यवर्णनम्.-........ -..... 145 5
6.2.m: 65. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Brahmeśvara liṅga: Therein, the daitya Puloma going to the Milk Ocean with his army to conquer Viṣṇu; seeing that, Brahmā going to the Mahākāla forest to conquer the daitya; performing austerity there, the description of the defeat of the daitya effected by pleased Śiva; Brahmā installing a liṅga in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Brahmeśvara liṅga. (145.5)

6.2.s: 66 atha jalpeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra jalpanāmakena rājñā pañcaputrānrājye saṃsthāpya vane gamanam tataḥ parasparabandhuvirodhena mṛtānpañcaputrāñjñātvā tadviyogena duḥkhitasya jalpasya rājño vasiṣṭhājñayā mahākālavane gamanam, tatra svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, jalpeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam....... -. ... 146 1
6.2.d: 66 अथ जल्पेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र जल्पनामकेन राज्ञा पञ्चपुत्रान्राज्ये संस्थाप्य वने गमनम् ततः परस्परबन्धुविरोधेन मृतान्पञ्चपुत्राञ्ज्ञात्वा तद्वियोगेन दुःखितस्य जल्पस्य राज्ञो वसिष्ठाज्ञया महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, जल्पेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्....... -. ... 146 1
6.2.m: 66. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Jalpeśvara liṅga: Therein, the king named Jalpa, after installing his five sons on the throne, going to the forest; then, learning that his five sons died through mutual fraternal discord, the king Jalpa, afflicted by separation from them, goes to the Mahākāla forest by Vasiṣṭha's command; installing a liṅga there in his own name; the description of the māhātmya of the Jalpeśvara liṅga. (146.1)

6.2.s: 67 atha kedāreśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra himapīḍitānāṃ sabrahmakānāṃ devānāṃ kailāse gamanam, tatra śivaṃ dhyātvā tadādeśātkedāreśvare gamanama, tatpuṇyaprabhāvena himapīḍānivṛttivarṇanam, kedāreśvaraliṅgamāhātmyavarṇanam- ... ... .. 147 1
6.2.d: 67 अथ केदारेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र हिमपीडितानां सब्रह्मकानां देवानां कैलासे गमनम्, तत्र शिवं ध्यात्वा तदादेशात्केदारेश्वरे गमनम, तत्पुण्यप्रभावेन हिमपीडानिवृत्तिवर्णनम्, केदारेश्वरलिङ्गमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- ... ... .. 147 1
6.2.m: 67. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kedāreśvara liṅga: Therein, the gods accompanied by Brahmā, afflicted by snow and cold, going to Kailāsa; meditating on Śiva there, going to Kedāreśvara by his command; by the power of that merit, the description of the cessation of the affliction from snow and cold; the description of the māhātmya of the Kedāreśvara liṅga. (147.1)

6.2.s: 68 atha piśāceśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, somanāmakasya śūdrasya durācāratvātpiśācatvaprāptivarṇanam, tatra piśācasya śākaṭāyanasya vrāhmaṇasya ca saṃvādavarṇanam, śākaṭāyanavacanātpiśācatvato muktihetormahākālavane gamanama, tatra liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya tasya piśācasya mokṣaprāptiḥ, piśāceśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanama.. 148
6.2.d: 68 अथ पिशाचेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, सोमनामकस्य शूद्रस्य दुराचारत्वात्पिशाचत्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, तत्र पिशाचस्य शाकटायनस्य व्राह्मणस्य च संवादवर्णनम्, शाकटायनवचनात्पिशाचत्वतो मुक्तिहेतोर्महाकालवने गमनम, तत्र लिंगं संपूज्य तस्य पिशाचस्य मोक्षप्राप्तिः, पिशाचेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम.. 148
6.2.m: 68. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Piśāceśvara liṅga: The description of a śūdra named Soma turning into a piśāca due to bad conduct; therein, the description of the dialogue between the piśāca and the brahmin Śākaṭāyana; going to the Mahākāla forest on the word of Śākaṭāyana for the sake of release from piśāca-hood; having worshipped the liṅga there, that piśāca's attainment of liberation; the description of the māhātmya of the Piśāceśvara liṅga. (148)

6.2.s: 60. atha saṅgameśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra patnīvacanātsubāhunā prāgjanmakathānakakathanam, tataḥ saṅgameśvarakṛpayā rājyamupabhujyānte mokṣaprāptivarṇanam, saṃgameśvara-liṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... . .. ... .. ... 149 2
6.2.d: 60. अथ सङ्गमेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र पत्नीवचनात्सुबाहुना प्राग्जन्मकथानककथनम्, ततः सङ्गमेश्वरकृपया राज्यमुपभुज्यान्ते मोक्षप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, संगमेश्वर-लिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... . .. ... .. ... 149 2
6.2.m: 69. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Saṅgameśvara liṅga: Therein, Subāhu telling the story of his previous birth at his wife's behest; then, after enjoying the kingdom by the grace of Saṅgameśvara, the description of the attainment of liberation in the end; the description of the māhātmya of the Saṅgameśvara liṅga. (149.2)

6.2.s: 70 atha durdhaṣeśvaraliṃgamāhāmyavarṇanam, durdharṣanāmno rājño mṛgayāyai vane gamanam, tatra kalpākhyasyarṣeḥ kanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tayā mohitena tatra vāsakaraṇam, rājyasya nāśe tatprāptyai mahākālavane śivapūjanena tasya rājyaprāptiḥ sarvasukhopabhogānantaramante mokṣaprāptiśca, durdharṣeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam. .. .... .151 1
6.2.d: 70 अथ दुर्धषेश्वरलिंगमाहाम्यवर्णनम्, दुर्धर्षनाम्नो राज्ञो मृगयायै वने गमनम्, तत्र कल्पाख्यस्यर्षेः कन्यां दृष्ट्वा तया मोहितेन तत्र वासकरणम्, राज्यस्य नाशे तत्प्राप्त्यै महाकालवने शिवपूजनेन तस्य राज्यप्राप्तिः सर्वसुखोपभोगानन्तरमन्ते मोक्षप्राप्तिश्च, दुर्धर्षेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्. .. .... .151 1
6.2.m: 70. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Durdharṣeśvara liṅga: The king named Durdharṣa going to the forest to hunt; seeing there the daughter of the seer named Kalpa, being infatuated with her and dwelling there; upon the loss of his kingdom, worshipping Śiva in the Mahākāla forest to regain it, his attainment of the kingdom, and after enjoying all pleasures, in the end the attainment of liberation; the description of the māhātmya of the Durdharṣeśvara liṅga. (151.1)

6.2.s: 71 atha prayāgeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śaṃtanunā vṛtāyā gaṃgāyā aṣṭaputraprāptivarṇanam gaṃgāyā manuṣyayonito muktiprāptyarthaṃ nāradavacanātprayāgeśvare gamanam, liṃgapūjanena pāpānnivṛttiḥ prayāgeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam ... ... 152 2
6.2.d: 71 अथ प्रयागेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शंतनुना वृताया गंगाया अष्टपुत्रप्राप्तिवर्णनम् गंगाया मनुष्ययोनितो मुक्तिप्राप्त्यर्थं नारदवचनात्प्रयागेश्वरे गमनम्, लिंगपूजनेन पापान्निवृत्तिः प्रयागेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् ... ... 152 2
6.2.m: 71. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Prayāgeśvara liṅga: Therein, the description of Gaṅgā, chosen by Śaṃtanu, obtaining eight sons; Gaṅgā going to Prayāgeśvara on Nārada's advice to obtain release from human birth; cessation from sin by worship of the liṅga; the description of the māhātmya of the Prayāgeśvara liṅga. (152.2)

6.2.s: 72 atha candrādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śabareṇa parābhūtāndevāndṛṣṭvā candrasūryayorvaikuṃṭhe gamanam, viṣṇvājñayā tayormahākālavane gatvā śivapūjane kṛte śivaliṃgato jyotirnirgatya tena jyotiṣā śaṃbarasya parājayakaraṇavarṇanam, candrādityeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam 154 1
6.2.d: 72 अथ चन्द्रादित्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शबरेण पराभूतान्देवान्दृष्ट्वा चन्द्रसूर्ययोर्वैकुंठे गमनम्, विष्ण्वाज्ञया तयोर्महाकालवने गत्वा शिवपूजने कृते शिवलिंगतो ज्योतिर्निर्गत्य तेन ज्योतिषा शंबरस्य पराजयकरणवर्णनम्, चन्द्रादित्येश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 154 1
6.2.m: 72. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Candrādityeśvara [liṅga]: Therein, seeing the gods defeated by Śambara, the Moon and Sun going to Vaikuṇṭha; by Viṣṇu's command, the two going to the Mahākāla forest, and when worship of Śiva is performed, a light emerges from the Śivaliṅga; the description of Śambara's defeat by that light; the description of the māhātmya of the Candrādityeśvara liṅga. (154.1)

6.2.s: 73 atha karabheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, mṛgayāṃ kartuṃ gatasya rājño vīraketoḥ karabhasyānudhāvanam, mahāraṇye karabhasyāntardhānam, tataḥ kasyacidṛṣeranujñayā mahākālavane karabheśvarapūjanena kailāsapadaprāptivarṇanam, karabheśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam 155 2
6.2.d: 73 अथ करभेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, मृगयां कर्तुं गतस्य राज्ञो वीरकेतोः करभस्यानुधावनम्, महारण्ये करभस्यान्तर्धानम्, ततः कस्यचिदृषेरनुज्ञया महाकालवने करभेश्वरपूजनेन कैलासपदप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, करभेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् 155 2
6.2.m: 73. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Karabheśvara liṅga: King Vīraketu, having gone to hunt, pursues a camel; the disappearance of the camel in the great forest; then, by the permission of a certain seer, worshipping Karabheśvara in the Mahākāla forest, the description of his attainment of the abode of Kailāsa; the description of the māhātmya of the Karabheśvara liṅga. (155.2)

6.2.s: 74 atha rājasthaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam - tatra brahmaṇā sṛṣṭiṃ vidhāya arājakāṃ dṛṣṭvā ripuṃjayāya rājadānam , tena ripuṃjayena rājñā putravatprajāpālanaṃ kurvatā devadattātivṛṣṭyanāvṛṣṭyāditrāsaṃ nirākartuṃ mahākālavane gatvā śivaṃ saṃpūjya tatkṛpayā prajānāṃ sukhaprāptikaraṇavarṇanam, rājasthaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanama..... 157 1
6.2.d: 74 अथ राजस्थलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - तत्र ब्रह्मणा सृष्टिं विधाय अराजकां दृष्ट्वा रिपुंजयाय राजदानम् , तेन रिपुंजयेन राज्ञा पुत्रवत्प्रजापालनं कुर्वता देवदत्तातिवृष्ट्यनावृष्ट्यादित्रासं निराकर्तुं महाकालवने गत्वा शिवं संपूज्य तत्कृपया प्रजानां सुखप्राप्तिकरणवर्णनम्, राजस्थलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम..... 157 1
6.2.m: 74. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Rājasthaleśvara liṅga: Therein, Brahmā, having performed creation and seeing it kingless, bestowing sovereignty on Ripuṃjaya; that king Ripuṃjaya, while protecting his subjects like sons, goes to the Mahākāla forest and worships Śiva to dispel the fear of excessive rain, drought, and the like caused by the gods; the description of the subjects attaining happiness through his grace; the description of the māhātmya of the Rājasthaleśvara liṅga. (157.1)

6.2.s: 75 atha vaḍaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra maṇibhadraputreṇa vaḍalasaṃjñakena bhāryayā sākaṃ krīḍituṃ vane gamanama, tatra krīṅāvanarakṣitṛbhī rākṣasaiḥ samaṃ vaḍalasya yuddham, tatra rākṣasaparājayaḥ tena mvaputrasya karmaṇā kruddhena maṇibhadreṇa yakṣeṇa svaputrāya vaḍalāya śāpadānam, śāpanivṛttyarthaṃ vaḍalasya mahākālavane gamanama, śivapūjanena tasya mokṣaprāptivarṇanam, vaḍaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam .. .. 158 1
6.2.d: 75 अथ वडलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र मणिभद्रपुत्रेण वडलसंज्ञकेन भार्यया साकं क्रीडितुं वने गमनम, तत्र क्रीङावनरक्षितृभी राक्षसैः समं वडलस्य युद्धम्, तत्र राक्षसपराजयः तेन म्वपुत्रस्य कर्मणा क्रुद्धेन मणिभद्रेण यक्षेण स्वपुत्राय वडलाय शापदानम्, शापनिवृत्त्यर्थं वडलस्य महाकालवने गमनम, शिवपूजनेन तस्य मोक्षप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, वडलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् .. .. 158 1
6.2.m: 75. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Vaḍaleśvara [liṅga]: Therein, the son of Maṇibhadra named Vaḍala goes to the forest to sport with his wife; there, Vaḍala's battle with the rākṣasas who guard the pleasure-grove; the defeat of the rākṣasas there; the yakṣa Maṇibhadra, angered by that act of his son, cursing his son Vaḍala; Vaḍala going to the Mahākāla forest for the removal of the curse; the description of his attainment of liberation through the worship of Śiva; the description of the māhātmya of the Vaḍaleśvara liṅga. (158.1)

6.2.s: 76 athāruṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kaśyapasaṃbhūtasya vinatāsutasyāruṇasya nāradopadeśānmahākālavane gatvā śivapūjanena sūryasārathitvaprāptivarṇanam, aruṇeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam- ... 159 2
6.2.d: 76 अथारुणेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कश्यपसंभूतस्य विनतासुतस्यारुणस्य नारदोपदेशान्महाकालवने गत्वा शिवपूजनेन सूर्यसारथित्वप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, अरुणेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्- ... 159 2
6.2.m: 76. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Aruṇeśvara [liṅga]: Therein, Aruṇa, born of Kaśyapa and son of Vinatā, going to the Mahākāla forest on Nārada's instruction and worshipping Śiva, the description of his attainment of being the charioteer of the Sun; the description of the māhātmya of the Aruṇeśvara liṅga. (159.2)

6.2.s: 77 atha puṣpadaṃteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra śinināmakadvijena putraprāptyarthamīśvarasyārādhane kṛte sati tatprasādena tasya puṣpadantanāmakaputraprāptivarṇanama, puṣpadantena mahākālavane śivaliṃgasthāpanam, puṣpadanteśvaraliṃgamāhāntyavarṇanam-..... 160 2
6.2.d: 77 अथ पुष्पदंतेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र शिनिनामकद्विजेन पुत्रप्राप्त्यर्थमीश्वरस्याराधने कृते सति तत्प्रसादेन तस्य पुष्पदन्तनामकपुत्रप्राप्तिवर्णनम, पुष्पदन्तेन महाकालवने शिवलिंगस्थापनम्, पुष्पदन्तेश्वरलिंगमाहान्त्यवर्णनम्-..... 160 2
6.2.m: 77. Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Puṣpadanteśvara liṅga: Therein, when worship of Īśvara was performed by the twice-born named Śini for the sake of obtaining a son, the description of his obtaining a son named Puṣpadanta by his grace; Puṣpadanta installing a Śivaliṅga in the Mahākāla forest; the description of the māhātmya of the Puṣpadanteśvara liṅga. (160.2)

6.2.s: 78 citrasenanṛpaterviraktāyāḥ kanyakāyā vacanādavimuktakṣetra āgamanam, tatra śivaliṃgapūjanena tasya muktiprāptivarṇanam avimukteśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.. ... 162 1
6.2.d: 78 चित्रसेननृपतेर्विरक्तायाः कन्यकाया वचनादविमुक्तक्षेत्र आगमनम्, तत्र शिवलिंगपूजनेन तस्य मुक्तिप्राप्तिवर्णनम् अविमुक्तेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.. ... 162 1
6.2.m: 78 Description of King Citrasena coming to the Avimuktakṣetra on the advice of his dispassionate daughter; description of his attainment of liberation through the worship of the Śivaliṅga there; description of the māhātmya of the Avimukteśvara liṅga. ... 162 1

6.2.s: 79 atha hanumatkeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra hanumadbālalīlāvarṇanapuraḥsaraṃ liṃgapūjanena hanumato balaprāptivarṇanam, rāvaṇavadhānaṃtaraṃ rāmarājyābhiṣekottaraṃ rāmaprastutahanumadvarṇane kenaciddvijena hanumato'dhikṣepe kṛte hanumatā mahākālavane gatvā śivapūjanam, hanumatkeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyam. .... -163 2
6.2.d: 79 अथ हनुमत्केश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र हनुमद्बाललीलावर्णनपुरःसरं लिंगपूजनेन हनुमतो बलप्राप्तिवर्णनम्, रावणवधानंतरं रामराज्याभिषेकोत्तरं रामप्रस्तुतहनुमद्वर्णने केनचिद्द्विजेन हनुमतोऽधिक्षेपे कृते हनुमता महाकालवने गत्वा शिवपूजनम्, हनुमत्केश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यम्. .... -163 2
6.2.m: 79 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Hanumatkeśvara liṅga: wherein, prefaced by the description of Hanumān's childhood play, his attainment of strength through the worship of the liṅga is described; after the slaying of Rāvaṇa and following the consecration of Rāma's reign, when a certain brahmin rebuked Hanumān during Rāma's praise of him, Hanumān's going to the Mahākālavana and worshipping Śiva; the māhātmya of the Hanumatkeśvara liṅga. ... 163 2

6.2.s: 80 atha svapneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kalmāṣapādakathāvarṇanapūrvaka duḥsvapnanāśaka svapneśvarākhyānavarṇanam , svapneśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam.... .. 164 2
6.2.d: 80 अथ स्वप्नेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कल्माषपादकथावर्णनपूर्वक दुःस्वप्ननाशक स्वप्नेश्वराख्यानवर्णनम् , स्वप्नेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्.... .. 164 2
6.2.m: 80 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Svapneśvara liṅga: wherein, prefaced by the narration of the story of Kalmāṣapāda, the story of Svapneśvara that destroys bad dreams is described; the description of the māhātmya of the Svapneśvara liṅga. ... 164 2

6.2.s: 81 atha piṃgaleśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra caturdiksthitānāṃ caturligānāṃ varṇanam ,tatra piṃgalānāmnyā piṃgalakanyakayā pitṛmātṛhīnayā prāgjanmaduṣkṛtasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā dharmānujñayā mahākālavane gamanam, tatra gatvā svanāmnā liṃgasthāpanam, piṃgaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam - 166 1
6.2.d: 81 अथ पिंगलेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र चतुर्दिक्स्थितानां चतुर्लिगानां वर्णनम् ,तत्र पिंगलानाम्न्या पिंगलकन्यकया पितृमातृहीनया प्राग्जन्मदुष्कृतस्मरणं कृत्वा धर्मानुज्ञया महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र गत्वा स्वनाम्ना लिंगस्थापनम्, पिंगलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम् - 166 1
6.2.m: 81 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Piṅgaleśvara liṅga: wherein is described the four liṅgas situated in the four directions; therein, the Piṅgala maiden named Piṅgalā, bereft of father and mother, remembering her evil deeds from a past life, goes to the Mahākālavana with the permission of Dharma; having gone there, she establishes a liṅga under her own name; description of the māhātmya of Piṅgaleśvara. 166 1

6.2.s: 82 atha kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsanasamaye vīrabhadra bhadrakālyādibhiḥ parājitānāṃ dakṣādīnāṃ mahākālavane gamanam, tatra liṃgapūjanena sarveṣāṃ kāyāvarohaṇātkāyāvarohaṇeśvaretināmasthāpanam, kāyāvarohaṇeśvaraliṃga māhātmyavarṇanam...... . ...... . 168 1
6.2.d: 82 अथ कायावरोहणेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसनसमये वीरभद्र भद्रकाल्यादिभिः पराजितानां दक्षादीनां महाकालवने गमनम्, तत्र लिंगपूजनेन सर्वेषां कायावरोहणात्कायावरोहणेश्वरेतिनामस्थापनम्, कायावरोहणेश्वरलिंग माहात्म्यवर्णनम्...... . ...... . 168 1
6.2.m: 82 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Kāyāvarohaṇeśvara liṅga: wherein, at the time of the destruction of Dakṣa's sacrifice, Dakṣa and others, defeated by Vīrabhadra, Bhadrakālī, and others, go to the Mahākālavana; because of everyone casting off their bodies through the worship of the liṅga there, the name Kāyāvarohaṇeśvara was established; description of the māhātmya of the Kāyāvarohaṇeśvara liṅga. ... 168 1

6.2.s: 83 atha bilveśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra kapilena śivamārādhyāvadhyatvasaṃpādanamakṣayatvasaṃpādanaṃ ca, tathā bilvena nṛpeṇa .viṣṇumārādhya kapilo māṃ prati 'tvatto'haṃ bibhemi' iti yathā vadettathā kuru ityādivaraprārthanākaraṇam, tasmai 'tathāstu' ityuktvā viṣṇunā varapradānam, svadattaṃ varaṃ satyaṃ kartuṃ viṣṇunā kapilasya prārthanākaraṇam, svavākyaṃ tiraskurvatā kapilena samaṃ kṛṣṇasya yuddhavarṇanam, tatra kṛṣṇaparājayaḥ, tato bilvanṛpeṇa śakravacanādbilveśvaramārādhya kapilamukhena 'ahaṃ tvatto bibhemi' iti bhāṣābandhakaraṇam, bilveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam... ... 169 2
6.2.d: 83 अथ बिल्वेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र कपिलेन शिवमाराध्यावध्यत्वसंपादनमक्षयत्वसंपादनं च, तथा बिल्वेन नृपेण .विष्णुमाराध्य कपिलो मां प्रति ऽत्वत्तोऽहं बिभेमि' इति यथा वदेत्तथा कुरु इत्यादिवरप्रार्थनाकरणम्, तस्मै ऽतथास्तु' इत्युक्त्वा विष्णुना वरप्रदानम्, स्वदत्तं वरं सत्यं कर्तुं विष्णुना कपिलस्य प्रार्थनाकरणम्, स्ववाक्यं तिरस्कुर्वता कपिलेन समं कृष्णस्य युद्धवर्णनम्, तत्र कृष्णपराजयः, ततो बिल्वनृपेण शक्रवचनाद्बिल्वेश्वरमाराध्य कपिलमुखेन ऽअहं त्वत्तो बिभेमि' इति भाषाबन्धकरणम्, बिल्वेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्... ... 169 2
6.2.m: 83 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Bilveśvara liṅga: wherein Kapila, having worshipped Śiva, secures invulnerability and imperishability; likewise, King Bilva, having worshipped Viṣṇu, requests a boon saying: 'Act in such a way that Kapila says to me: "I am afraid of you"'; Viṣṇu granting the boon to him, saying 'So be it'; Viṣṇu entreating Kapila in order to make true the boon he granted; description of the battle between Kṛṣṇa and Kapila who disregarded his word; therein, the defeat of Kṛṣṇa; then King Bilva, upon the instruction of Indra, worships Bilveśvara and secures the promise from Kapila's mouth: 'I am afraid of you'; description of the māhātmya of Bilveśvara. ... 169 2

6.2.s:
84 athottareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, tatra parīkṣinnāmakasyāyodhyādhipatermṛgayārthamaraṇye gamanama, tatra kayācitkanyayā samaṃ praśnottaragadyaprabandhena saṃbhāṣaṇam, tāṃ gṛhītvā viharati rājani tayā kanyayā vāpīṃ praviśya pātāle gamanam, parīkṣitā śokakaraṇam, parīkṣidājñayā pradhānādibhirdarduravadhakaraṇam, tata ekena vṛddhadardureṇa nijapṛrvajanmakathānakakathanapūrvakaṃ gālavaśāpena darduratvaprāptikathanam, dardureṇa
kanyāsmaraṇe kṛte sati smaraṇottaramāgatāyāḥ kanyāyāstasmai parīkṣite samarpaṇam, uttareśvarapūjanena dardurasya gālavadattaśāpanivṛttiḥ, uttareśvaraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanam, itthamavantīkṣetrasthitacaturaśītiliṃgamāhātmyakathāphalaśrutivarṇanam, āvantyakhaṇḍasthita caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmyopasaṃhāravarṇanam . .. - ... 171 1

6.2.d:
84 अथोत्तरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, तत्र परीक्षिन्नामकस्यायोध्याधिपतेर्मृगयार्थमरण्ये गमनम, तत्र कयाचित्कन्यया समं प्रश्नोत्तरगद्यप्रबन्धेन संभाषणम्, तां गृहीत्वा विहरति राजनि तया कन्यया वापीं प्रविश्य पाताले गमनम्, परीक्षिता शोककरणम्, परीक्षिदाज्ञया प्रधानादिभिर्दर्दुरवधकरणम्, तत एकेन वृद्धदर्दुरेण निजपृर्वजन्मकथानककथनपूर्वकं गालवशापेन दर्दुरत्वप्राप्तिकथनम्, दर्दुरेण
कन्यास्मरणे कृते सति स्मरणोत्तरमागतायाः कन्यायास्तस्मै परीक्षिते समर्पणम्, उत्तरेश्वरपूजनेन दर्दुरस्य गालवदत्तशापनिवृत्तिः, उत्तरेश्वरलिंगमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, इत्थमवन्तीक्षेत्रस्थितचतुरशीतिलिंगमाहात्म्यकथाफलश्रुतिवर्णनम्, आवन्त्यखण्डस्थित चतुरशीतिलिंगमाहात्म्योपसंहारवर्णनम् . .. - ... 171 1

6.2.m:
84 Now, the description of the māhātmya of the Uttareśvara liṅga: wherein the ruler of Ayodhyā named Parīkṣit goes to the forest for hunting; there, he converses with a certain maiden by means of questions and answers composed in prose; while the king sports after taking her [with him], that maiden enters a stepped well and goes to Pātāla; Parīkṣit's lamentation; by Parīkṣit's order, the slaughter of frogs by his ministers and others; then, an old frog relates the story of his own previous birth and tells of his becoming a frog due to the curse of Gālava; when the frog remembers the maiden, her return upon being remembered, and handing her over to that Parīkṣit; the frog's release from the curse given by Gālava through the worship of Uttareśvara; description of the māhātmya of the Uttareśvara liṅga; thus, the description of the fruit of hearing the stories of the māhātmya of the eighty-four liṅgas situated in the Avantīkṣetra; description of the conclusion to the māhātmya of the eighty-four liṅgas situated in the Āvantyakhaṇḍa. ... 171 1
